   ), existing AS (

   ), compatible AS (
     SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM existing)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT slug FROM proposed EXCEPT SELECT slug FROM existing)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT slug FROM existing EXCEPT SELECT slug FROM proposed) AS matches
   ), next_version AS (
